concerns.text: The plan validates the predictive model using a synthetic composition‑Tg dataset that is generated in‑house (see Summary step 1). Because the ground‑truth Tg values are not obtained from an independent, experimentally verified source, the validation target is not independent of the predictors. If Tg is generated as a function of the same atomic descriptors (radius mismatch, electronegativity difference, VEC) used for modeling, the evaluation becomes tautological: the model is essentially learning the deterministic rule used to create the data, guaranteeing high R² and rendering the claimed ‘predictive influence of alloying’ scientifically meaningless.
